raw_text: The ISPR deepfake video has been thoroughly debunked at this point. What concerns me more is the speed of amplification — it reached 2 million views within 6 hours of upload. The account network pushing this content overlaps significantly with accounts that pushed the Balakot denial narrative in 2019. Several Indian defence journalists have pointed out that the rank insignia in the video is wrong: the officer is shown wearing Wing Commander stripes but the uniform pattern matches the pre-2020 design. PIB has now officially flagged it. The real question is whether Election Commission guidelines cover foreign-origin AI-generated content targeting Indian elections.
